name: parallel index scan worker, one leaf through leaf_slot_walker + overflow_drain_fsm the way a worker drives it: rows, errors, the range's end, trace counters, key value clears, and PR#8490's look-ahead (read_ahead -> evaluate_ahead -> next_key (ahead)) -- the read-ahead hints, and a user cancel that only the look-ahead sees (dropped by stop_at_error's er_clear)
fakes: Real: leaf_slot_walker (TU), overflow_drain_fsm (extra), scan_index_read_ahead () (extra scan_manager.c; absent before PR#8490 -- W7 then passes trivially). The driver is px_scan_task.cpp's worker loop (its interrupt check before and after the leaf, :1212-1230) with slot_iterator_index::set_page () / next_qualified_slot_with_peek () / finalize () (px_scan_slot_iterator_index.cpp:52-92) copied. The transaction's interrupt flag: every engine call that checks it does what pgbuf_fix () does (page_buffer.c:2350-2358: logtb_is_interrupted (thread_p, true, ..) clears the flag, ER_INTERRUPTED, failure) and db_sleep () (arithmetic.c:5121-5124); a cancel sets the flag right before one chosen check. btree_read_record: an overflow key (BTREE_LEAF_RECORD_OVERFLOW_KEY) fixes two overflow pages, overflow_get_length () and overflow_get () (btree.c:2197, 2211) -- a check each, on failure the key NULL and ER_FAILED (btree.c:2199, 4855-4858); every key a COPY owning memory (clear_key, btree.c:4861), in-page keys fix nothing; a key may fail every time with a fixed error. eval_key_filter: a SLEEP key makes one check per evaluation; false or failing keys. heap_get_visible_version: the heap page fix is one check, else visible. btree_record_process_objects: the key's leaf OIDs, no snapshot. spage_get_record / btree_node_number_of_keys / btree_leaf_record_is_fence: the leaf's records, no fence. btree_compare_search_key / btree_compare_key_to_bound: integer order of the slot number (INF_INF or INF_LE range). pr_clear_value: frees when need_clear then NULL (object_primitive.c:1856-2012) -- each key carries a token, so a double clear or a key never cleared is seen. leaf_page_dispatcher::release_leaf lets the leaf go; ::signal_chain_ended records (the leaf is the frontier, kept) -- px_scan_index_leaf_page_dispatcher.cpp:255-271, 641-655. pgbuf_read_ahead records pages and the lookups done. logtb_set_tran_index_interrupt sets the flag (log_tran_table.c:2932-2992, notification and sleeper wake-up not modeled) -- used only by the G23-01 proposal mutant. input_handler_index is placement-new'd once, its key range vector set through explicit-instantiation member pointers; SCAN_ID, INDX_INFO and the thread entry are calloc'd, never constructed.
